{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "achow101",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "Concept ACK despite the double-scan performance trade-off"
    },
    {
      "login": "jeanpablojp",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "ACKed earlier commit, but later demonstrated with a benchmarked test that cascading receives past scan_end are missed, leaving the wallet balance short"
    },
    {
      "login": "molnard",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "Concept ACK on the bug fix, but raised that child transactions spending lookahead outputs positioned after the expansion point remain missed"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "c:5234820518",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "-walletnotify is invoked a second time for unchanged transactions during full second scan passes",
      "quote": "The second walk also re-runs -walletnotify. AddToWallet notifies on every call, so the script fires again for transactions that did not change",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "reviewer accepted the prefix-bounded re-scan in commit 278564b",
      "author_replies": ["c:5262264789"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:5264417632",
      "status_by_quote": "ACK 278564b95c0607fd54892d42a60a001e6b32a236"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3872661031",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Avoid calling collect_range_ends() when SyncTransaction() returns false",
      "quote": "We can avoid some calls to collect_range_ends() by checking the return value of SyncTransaction().",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author implemented the skip in 1d9de0e6",
      "author_replies": ["rc:3883805239", "rc:3883892813", "c:5457594935", "c:5457638606"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3883892813",
      "status_by_quote": "Done."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3872753832",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Use std::move when assigning cur to range_ends",
      "quote": "range_ends = std::move(cur);",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "implemented in 1d9de0e6",
      "author_replies": ["rc:3883736747", "rc:3883892059", "c:5457638606"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3883892059",
      "status_by_quote": "Done."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3872872400",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Combine the initial scan and prefix rescans into a single loop using scan_end as the bound",
      "quote": "The initial full-block scan and the subsequent prefix rescans can be combined by using scan_end as the exclusive upper bound",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "consolidated into a single while loop in 1d9de0e6",
      "author_replies": ["rc:3883858331", "rc:3883893881", "c:5457594935", "c:5457638606"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3883893881",
      "status_by_quote": "Done, thanks!"
    },
    {
      "id": "r:5041935034",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "If a child tx spends a lookahead parent later in the block, prefix rescan misses the child and leaves the parent output classified as unspent",
      "quote": "The parent output can remain classified as unspent, leaving the wallet balance incorrect until another rescan.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author confirmed the limitation and documented it as a follow-up in the description",
      "author_replies": ["c:5457594935", "c:5457638606"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:5457594935",
      "status_by_quote": "I'd like to treat this the same way — documenting it as a second known limitation rather than expanding this fix."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5459727026",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "A cascading receive past scan_end that becomes wallet-relevant only after the prefix pass recovers an earlier tx is missed, leaving the wallet balance short",
      "quote": "A receive only becomes the wallet's once the prefix pass recovers an earlier one, and it sits past scan_end. The balance comes out 0.00050000 short.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "author deferred to analyze how the suggested algorithm behaves and will report back",
      "author_replies": ["c:5463636476"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "r:4900292627",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "Agrees with the concept of fixing the lookahead miss despite scanning blocks twice when a lookahead output is found",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "read",
      "areas": []
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5264417632",
      "verdict": "ACK",
      "reason": "ACK 278564b95c0607fd54892d42a60a001e6b32a236",
      "substantive": false,
      "evidence": "none",
      "areas": []
    },
    {
      "id": "r:5041935034",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "Agrees the bug is valid while noting the unhandled child-spend case",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "read",
      "areas": []
    }
  ],
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "author",
      "what": "author analyzing jeanpablojp's test case and proposed loop implementation",
      "id": "c:5463636476"
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Added suggestions from molnard that were implemented in 1d9de0e6. Marked jeanpablojp's objection on cascading receives as open because the author's reply was a deferral promising to report back soon."
}
